items.title: Arbiter: Detecting Interference in LLM Agent System Prompts
items.title_zh: Arbiter：检测 LLM 智能体系统提示中的干扰
items.summary: Arbiter combines formal evaluation rules with multi-model LLM scouring to detect interference patterns in the system prompts of Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI. It reports 152 findings in undirected scouring and 21 hand-labeled interference patterns for one vendor, including a Gemini CLI memory-system data-loss finding consistent with an issue Google filed and patched.

items.title: MEMO: Memory-Augmented Model Context Optimization for Robust Multi-Turn Multi-Agent LLM Games
items.title_zh: MEMO：面向稳健多轮多智能体 LLM 游戏的记忆增强上下文优化
items.summary: MEMO is a self-play framework that optimizes inference-time context through a persistent memory bank and tournament-style prompt evolution with uncertainty-aware selection. Across five text-based games, it raised GPT-4o-mini's mean win rate from 25.1% to 49.5% and reduced run-to-run variance.

items.title: Quantifying the Accuracy and Cost Impact of Design Decisions in Budget-Constrained Agentic LLM Search
items.title_zh: 量化预算受限的智能体 LLM 搜索中设计决策对准确率与成本的影响
items.summary: This controlled measurement study examines how search depth, retrieval strategy, and completion budget affect accuracy and cost in agentic RAG under fixed constraints. Across six LLMs and three QA benchmarks, accuracy improved with additional searches up to a small cap, and hybrid lexical-dense retrieval with lightweight reranking produced the largest average gains.

items.title: Agentic Critical Training
items.title_zh: Agentic Critical Training：通过行动判别训练智能体
items.summary: Agentic Critical Training uses reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards to teach models to judge actions, pairing an expert action with an alternative sampled from the initial policy and rewarding only selection of the expert action. On ALFWorld-ID, WebShop, and ScienceWorld it yields average gains of 5.85 points over imitation learning and 4.12 points over imitation learning followed by RL.

items.title: Learning When to Sample: Confidence-Aware Selective Sampling for Efficient Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
items.title_zh: 学会何时采样：面向高效思维链推理的置信度感知选择性采样
items.summary: The framework analyzes a single chain-of-thought trajectory at inference time to decide whether to rely on it or trigger multi-path sampling. Trained on MedQA and transferred to MathQA, MedMCQA, and MMLU, it cut token usage by 71.7% versus full multi-path reasoning while accuracy changed by -0.41 percentage points.

items.title: The ARC of Progress towards AGI: A Living Survey of Abstraction and Reasoning
items.title_zh: 通往 AGI 的 ARC 之路：抽象与推理的持续更新综述
items.summary: This living survey presents the first cross-generation analysis of 82 approaches across three ARC-AGI benchmark versions, finding consistent 2-3x performance drops from ARC-AGI-1 to ARC-AGI-2 across program-synthesis, neuro-symbolic, and neural paradigms. It reports top scores of 93.0% on ARC-AGI-1, 68.8% on ARC-AGI-2, and 13% on ARC-AGI-3, while humans remain near-perfect.

items.title: Security Considerations for Multi-agent Systems
items.title_zh: 多智能体系统的安全考量
items.summary: The study characterizes multi-agent system security risks as 193 main threat items across nine risk categories and scores 16 AI security frameworks against them. No framework achieved majority coverage of any single category, with non-determinism and data leakage the least addressed, while the OWASP Agentic Security Initiative led overall at 65.3% coverage.

items.title: fabio-rovai/open-ontologies
items.title_zh: open-ontologies：面向生产本体的变更管理工具
items.summary: Open-ontologies is a Rust tool for planning, applying, and rolling back changes to a production ontology, with a blast-radius report and a proof that an auditor can re-check.

items.title: OpenAI to acquire Promptfoo
items.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Promptfoo, an AI security platform that helps enterprises identify and remediate vulnerabilities in AI systems during development.

items.title: Tencent launches OpenClaw-like workplace AI agent WorkBuddy
items.title_zh: 腾讯推出类 OpenClaw 办公 AI 智能体 WorkBuddy
items.summary: Tencent has launched WorkBuddy, an OpenClaw-like desktop AI agent for workplace tasks that supports local installation without cloud deployment, according to TechNode.
